nodes.notes: Point a Stripe webhook endpoint at this URL for the event checkout.session.completed. For production, verify the Stripe-Signature header (add a Code node using STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET) before trusting the payload.

=

You're protected.

MarkSentry is now monitoring USPTO trademark filings for marks similar to:

{{$('Extract Subscriber').first().json.business_name}}

What happens next:

  1. Your baseline scan runs tonight — your first report covers similar marks that already exist, within 24 hours.
  2. After that, we scan new filings weekly and email you only when something deserves attention.
  3. Once a month you'll get an "all clear" summary so you know the watch is running.

If the business name or industry above is wrong, just reply to this email and we'll fix your watch profile.

MarkSentry is not a law firm and does not provide legal advice. Reports are automated analyses of public USPTO records for informational purposes only.
